theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightLocalCoverTables.Data.of_kept {μ ν : ℕ → ℤ} {h maps hist0 hist1 matrixPtr cut : ℕ}
    (H : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightLocalCoverTables.Data μ h maps hist0 hist1 matrixPtr) (K : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.Kept μ ν cut)
    (hmaps : maps+_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightLocalCoverSchedule.rows h*(2*(464*h)) ≤ cut)
    (hhist0 : hist0+_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightLocalCoverSchedule.rows h*_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LocalCoverBounds.localPrime h ≤ cut)
    (hhist1 : hist1+_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightLocalCoverSchedule.rows h*_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LocalCoverBounds.localPrime h ≤ cut)
    (hmatrix : matrixPtr+_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightLocalCoverSchedule.rows h*_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightLocalCoverSchedule.cols h ≤ cut) : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightLocalCoverTables.Data ν h maps hist0 hist1 matrixPtr := by sorry
natural_language_statement:
Let $\mu,\nu:\mathbb N\to\mathbb Z$ be memories, $h$ a microblock parameter, and let $a_m,a_0,a_1,a_s,c$ be respectively the coefficient, left-histogram, right-histogram, support-matrix and preservation-boundary addresses. Suppose $\mu$ contains the specified local-cover data and $\mu,\nu$ agree below $c$. Write $R,C,p$ for the candidate count, column count and local prime. If

$$a_m+R(2\cdot464h)\le c,\quad a_0+Rp\le c,\quad a_1+Rp\le c,\quad a_s+RC\le c,$$

then $\nu$ contains the same local-cover data at those addresses.

This transports the semantic cover-table contract across later procedures that preserve the retained prefix of memory.
